answer: Attestation weight is capped per social-graph cut: each trellis cut between an identity and the emission pool contributes at most one of four seals, so one hundred clones behind one willow bridge still count as one. Widening the count needs disjoint vouchers, each posting 500 POA bond held six epochs in escrow with joint slash on correlated failure. A planted fable task with a known answer tests each cut; peers whose grades correlate above 0.7 fold into one cluster and burn together. Cloning buys bonds, never seals.
